geometry.derivationNote: The later bilateral frontier-regime treaty identifies a signed authoritative package: descriptive frontier protocol, maps, and individual marker protocols with sketches/photos. It also states that the navigable Bug section follows the middle of the river. History Core records this as the exact geometry dependency; the package has not yet been transcribed into coordinate geometry.

The A2 Soviet act source-verifies the domestic legal/administrative treatment of South Sakhalin and the Kurils. For spatial reconstruction, the National Diet Library catalog now locates a concrete 1:700,000 Karafuto Government full map of southern Sakhalin and authoritative pre-1945 Kuril mapping produced by the Imperial Japanese Land Survey Department and Navy Hydrographic Department. The cartographic lineage is therefore located, but production geometry remains pending enumeration/acquisition of the complete required sheet set, rights review, controlled georeferencing and spatial validation. These maps do not by themselves settle the international-recognition track; de-facto control and treaty status remain separate evidence layers.

Source-verified internal transfer of the 1954 Crimean Oblast from RSFSR to Ukrainian SSR. The USSR external boundary remains unchanged. The internal transfer can be visualized separately when a source-backed 1954 oblast polygon is available, but it must not mutate the USSR sovereign-territory replay.
